test_camofox_navigate: test the camofox_navigate function to navigate a browser tab to a URL with a task_id
test_camofox_soft_cleanup: test the camofox_soft_cleanup function to drop in-memory sessions when managed persistence is enabled
test_check_camofox_available: test the check_camofox_available function to verify Camofox server health via the /health endpoint
test_get_camofox_identity: test the get_camofox_identity function to derive stable userId and session_key from a Hermes profile
test_get_session: test the _get_session function to retrieve or create browser sessions with ephemeral or managed persistence modes
